entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return for a helmet. Just give me the return label.
Okay, I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could I get your order number?
It's VF-8675309. Look, I'm in a hurry, so if we can just get this done quickly.

Of course. Pulling that up now... one moment... Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet. And just so I can document this correctly, what was the reason for the return? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
It's the wrong color. My wife ordered it for me and it doesn't match my gear. The box is still unopened. I just need to send it back.

I understand completely. Let me just check the policy here... Okay, yep. You're unfortunately outside the 10-day return window, so we can absolutely process that for you. Getting the right gear is important for both comfort and safety on the road.
Great. So you're sending the label?

Yes, I've just authorized the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label and instructions within the next five minutes. Just attach that to the box and drop it off with the carrier.
Perfect. That's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
